rules.title: Component with an intent-filter has no android:exported
rules.fix: Android 12+: activities, services and receivers that use intent filters must declare android:exported, or the app can't be installed on Android 12 or higher. Set true for the LAUNCHER activity; in most other cases false.

rules.title: Foreground services without a foregroundServiceType
rules.fix: Apps targeting Android 14 must give foreground services a type (camera, location, mediaPlayback, dataSync and others), plus the matching permission. If a service isn't a foreground service, ignore this.

rules.title: Release build is signed with the debug key
rules.fix: Google's signing docs: the debug certificate is insecure by design and most app stores, including Google Play, do not accept apps signed with it. Create a release keystore and point the release build type at it.

rules.title: iOS app icon is missing or not 1024x1024
rules.fix: Apple's Human Interface Guidelines specify a 1024x1024 px square app icon for iOS (layered, via Icon Composer in Xcode 26, or an AppIcon asset). Add a 1024x1024 image to the icon set. Apple's upload validation of this was not confirmed.

rules.title: No launch screen configured
rules.fix: Apple documents UILaunchScreen (no storyboard) and UILaunchStoryboardName as the keys that define the launch screen. What happens without one is not stated on those pages.

rules.title: Deployment target below the App Store minimum
rules.fix: Since 9 September 2026, iOS and iPadOS apps uploaded to App Store Connect must target iOS 13 or later. Raise IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET (or the Podfile platform line). Extension and test targets may be listed too.

rules.title: CI builds with an Xcode older than the upload minimum
rules.fix: Since 28 April 2026, apps uploaded to App Store Connect must be built with Xcode 26 or later using the iOS 26 SDK. Update the Xcode version your CI uses.

rules.title: Push notification code without the aps-environment entitlement
rules.fix: Enable the Push Notifications capability in Xcode; that adds the aps-environment entitlement (Xcode sets development or production from the provisioning profile). If your signing is configured outside the repo, ignore this.

rules.title: Background mode without matching code
rules.fix: Guideline 2.5.4: multitasking apps may only use background services for their intended purposes (VoIP, audio playback, location, task completion, local notifications and so on). Remove modes you don't use.

rules.title: Payment SDK without an in-app purchase library
rules.fix: If the app sells digital content or features (subscriptions, in-game currency, premium access, unlocking functionality), Apple 3.1.1 requires in-app purchase and Google Play's Payments policy requires Play Billing. Physical goods and real-world services are different; if that is all you sell, ignore this.

rules.title: App Store text is over its length limit
rules.fix: App Store Connect limits: name 2 to 30 characters, subtitle 30, promotional text 170, description 4,000, keywords 100 bytes.

rules.title: Play listing text is over its length limit
rules.fix: Google Play limits: app name 30 characters, short description 80, full description 4,000.

rules.title: App Store screenshots have an unaccepted size or count
rules.fix: App Store Connect needs at least one and at most 10 screenshots per device size, in .jpeg, .jpg or .png, at one of the accepted pixel sizes (listed on the source page; framed or resized images fail).

rules.title: Play phone screenshot count is outside 2 to 8
rules.fix: Google Play wants two to eight phone screenshots on the main store listing.

rules.title: No privacy policy link found
rules.fix: Apple requires a Privacy Policy URL for iOS and macOS apps, and Google requires a valid privacy policy in both the store listing and inside the app. This check only looks in app code, config and store metadata files; the URL you enter in the store consoles is not visible here.

rules.title: User-generated content without report/block moderation
rules.fix: Apple 1.2 requires a way to filter objectionable content, a mechanism to report it, the ability to block abusive users, and published contact information. Google Play requires terms users accept, an in-app system to report and block, and ongoing moderation.

rules.title: Required-reason API used without a privacy manifest declaration
rules.fix: If your app's code uses a required-reason API (file timestamps, system boot time, disk space, active keyboards, UserDefaults), report the category and an approved reason in the app's privacy manifest under NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes. Since 1 May 2024 App Store Connect does not accept apps that don't. The requirement is documented for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, visionOS and watchOS, so macOS, Linux, Windows, Android and web folders are skipped. Detection is a text search of the app's own native code (Pods and vendored folders are skipped); frameworks and extensions need their own manifest if they use the API.

rules.title: SDKs from Apple's privacy-manifest list in use
rules.fix: Apple lists commonly used SDKs that must ship a privacy manifest and a signature when you submit an app that includes them (any version, and SDKs that repackage them). Make sure the versions you use include both. Detection reads dependency files only and cannot see versions.

rules.title: References Apple's private frameworks
rules.fix: Guideline 2.5.1: apps may only use public APIs. Remove the private framework references.

rules.title: Embeds a non-WebKit browser engine
rules.fix: Guideline 2.5.6: apps that browse the web must use WebKit and WebKit JavaScript, unless you hold the alternative-browser-engine entitlement (EU and Japan). Use WKWebView or apply for the entitlement.

rules.title: iPhone-only app
rules.fix: Guideline 2.4.1: iPhone apps should run on iPad whenever possible. Add iPad to the supported device families, or ignore this if iPhone-only is deliberate.

rules.title: In-app purchases without a restore mechanism
rules.fix: Guideline 3.1.1: make sure you have a restore mechanism for any restorable in-app purchases (non-consumables and subscriptions). Add a visible Restore Purchases action.

rules.title: Ad SDK in an extension, widget, App Clip or watch target
rules.fix: Guideline 2.5.18: display advertising should be limited to your main app binary and should not be included in extensions, App Clips, widgets, notifications, keyboards, watchOS apps and so on. Move the ad SDK out of that target.

rules.title: Health or fitness data APIs together with an ad SDK
rules.fix: Guideline 5.1.3: apps may not use or disclose to third parties data gathered in the health, fitness and medical research context (HealthKit, Motion and Fitness and similar) for advertising, marketing or other use-based data mining. Make sure the ad SDK never receives that data.

rules.title: Child-directed app with third-party analytics or ad SDKs
rules.fix: Apple 1.3 and 5.1.4: apps for kids should not include third-party analytics or third-party advertising, except in limited cases that follow the same terms. Google Play's Families policy allows only certified ad SDKs and no interest-based ads. Remove the SDKs or confirm they qualify.

rules.title: VPN app: guideline 5.4 applies
rules.fix: Guideline 5.4: VPN apps must use the NEVPNManager API, may only be offered by developers enrolled as an organization, must declare what user data is collected and how it is used before any purchase or use, and may not sell, use or disclose data to third parties.

rules.title: Screen recording code present
rules.fix: Guideline 2.5.14: apps must request explicit user consent and provide a clear visual or audible indication when recording, logging or otherwise making a record of user activity, including screen recordings.

rules.title: The app's main content is a remote website
rules.fix: Apple 4.2.2 says apps shouldn't primarily be web clippings or a collection of links, and 4.2 expects more than a repackaged website. Google Play's Spam policy does not allow apps whose primary purpose is a web view of a website without the owner's permission. If you own the site, add substantial native functionality or be ready to show ownership.

rules.title: WebView exposes an object with addJavascriptInterface
rules.fix: Google Play removes apps with the sensitive JavaScript interface vulnerability: an object added with addJavascriptInterface that untrusted web content can reach. Load only content you own into that WebView, or remove the interface (removeJavascriptInterface) before untrusted content loads.

rules.title: Cryptocurrency features: guideline 3.1.5 applies
rules.fix: Guideline 3.1.5: wallets must be offered by a developer enrolled as an organization; apps may not mine cryptocurrency on device (cloud mining only); exchanges need licensing in each country where offered; ICOs and crypto-securities trading must come from approved financial institutions.

rules.title: Keyboard extension: guideline 4.4.1 applies
rules.fix: Guideline 4.4.1: a keyboard extension must provide keyboard input, a way to switch to the next keyboard, and remain functional without full network access and without requiring full access; it may collect activity only to improve the keyboard, may not launch apps other than Settings, and may not repurpose keyboard buttons.
